text:
Priya S: Heads-up — we've been seeing rapid flips between Triton and CUTLASS on a subset of H100 hosts for seq_len=64 workloads. p95/p99 spikes correlate with probe windows and KV-hot requests. Thinking we need to recalibrate probe thresholds and add stronger fallback safeguards. Anyone else seeing this?

Alex W: Saw it this morning in canary. Oscillation looks rhythmic every ~30s when kv-cache hit-rate > 0.6. Logs show repeated probe wins then immediate fallback.

Priya S: Attaching quick sample of routing log (trimmed):
```
2026-03-17T09:12:01Z route_eval model=gpt-6b host=h100-3 seed=42 seq=64 probe_ms=9 -> chosen=triton score=0.72
2026-03-17T09:12:31Z route_eval model=gpt-6b host=h100-3 seed=47 seq=64 probe_ms=11 -> chosen=cutlass score=0.69
2026-03-17T09:13:01Z route_eval model=gpt-6b host=h100-3 seq=64 kv_hit=0.78 -> fallback=cutlass reason=queue_growth
```

Jorge M: Two quick hypotheses: (1) probe samples are too small and noisy at seq=64 -> false positives; (2) KV cache affinity isn't considered enough so cutoff decisions ignore the effective token cost.

Sam T: Agreed. We should try a per-arch/per-model hysteresis and make probe_rate adaptive based on kv_hit. E.g. lower probe_rate when kv_hit > 0.5.

Alex W: Proposed config tweak for experiment: 
```
kernel_router:
  probe_threshold_ms: 14   # increase from 10
  hysteresis_window: 6    # avoid flip flopping
  max_probe_rate: 0.01    # fewer probes under KV-hot
  kvcache_affinity: true
  per_arch_overrides:
    h100:
      prefer_cutlass_for_seq_le: 72
```

perf-bot: Perf telemetry for the last 2h (canary h100-*) -> kernel_route_oscillation_count: 42 -> 7 after initial tweak on canary-2. p99 latency improved 18% on the affected traffic slice.

Priya S: Nice. Can we reproduce more systematically with an autotune run? I want deterministic inputs and a CSV of route decisions.

Jorge M: Run this command in perf lab: 
```
./autotune \
  --model=gpt-6b \
  --device=h100 \
  --seq-len=64 \
  --kv-pattern=hot:0.75 \
  --probe-duration=10m \
  --batch-samples=3000 \
  --out=/tmp/tune_h100_seq64.csv
```

Sam T: Also add `--collect-route-streams` so we capture per-request chosen kernel and queue depth.

infra-bot: Noted. Reserving h100-3 for experiment window 11:00-12:00 UTC.

Alex W: After running the autotune with the config change + adaptive probe_rate we saw oscillation drop ~80% and p99 down ~0.15s on that slice. CUTLASS remained preferred for short sequences when kvcache_affinity=true.

Priya S: Good signal. Risks: might reduce exploration and miss better kernels for unusual load patterns. Proposal:
- Roll the config change to 10% of hosts as a canary (eng-runtime).
- Add metric kernel_route_oscillation_count and an alert at >5/min for a host.
- Add one additional probe-mode: `staged_probe` that uses longer probes but once a candidate wins, it must survive N requests before switch.

Jorge M: +1. Also let's add a lightweight regression test in CI that simulates KV-hot traffic and verifies no >2 flips per minute.

Sam T: I'll own the canary rollout and CI test. Planning to start tonight, will post status.

Priya S: Thanks. Sam, assign the ticket and include the autotune CSV and route traces. If canary looks good after 24h we'll promote and add the per-arch override to default profiles. :rocket: 

perf-bot: Ticket created: RT-3221 "Calibrate probe thresholds & fallback safeguards for triton/cutlass on H100 seq64". Linked artifacts: /artifacts/tune_h100_seq64.csv, /logs/route_stream_1719004321.log

Alex W: One minor note — ensure the console shows per-model chosen-kernel heatmap so SREs can spot hosts regressions quickly.

Priya S: Agreed. Adding to RT-3221. Thanks everyone.
